relations.support_notes:
Follows rTsegs dBang phyug seng ge (ID:4289) and precedes 'Dzam tsan ne (ID:6244) as abbot.
Since the upper college was only established during the tenure of 'Dzam tsa ne (ID:6244), the successor of Dad pa bzang po, it does not seem reasonable to regard him as the first abbot of the lower college.
